build.buildCommand:
ls -la && if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && echo '[build] entrou em frontend/' && ls -la; fi && if [ ! -f index.html ]; then echo 'Viabilidade Alares
' > index.html && echo '[build] index.html criado'; fi && if [ ! -f embed.html ]; then echo 'Embed
' > embed.html; fi && ls -la index.html embed.html package.json src && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend; fi && npm start
